 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if len(markers) != 2:
        return g
    # The motif is attached to one marker; choose the marker nearest all colored cells.
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
             if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    scores = [sum(abs(r-mr) + abs(c-mc) for r, c, _ in cells) for mr, mc in markers]
    source = 0 if scores[0] < scores[1] else 1
    sr, sc = markers[source]
    tr, tc = markers[1-source]
    dr, dc = tr-sr, tc-sc
    g[tr][tc] = 0
    for r, c, color in cells:
        rr, cc = r+dr, c+dc
        if 0 <= rr < len(g) and 0 <= cc < len(g[0]):
            g[rr][cc] = color
    return g
